headline: Nigeria DMO Raises Savings Bond Rates to Up to 14.25% for November
summary: Nigeria's Debt Management Office opened its November Federal Government Savings Bond offer, setting the three-year instrument interest rate at 14.25% per annum.
why: Changes in sovereign debt yields influence domestic fixed-income returns, government borrowing costs, and local investor asset allocation.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Higher savings bond yields increase sovereign borrowing rates.
